name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI Serverless Quickstart end-to-end. The FIREWORKS_API_KEY was already exported in the sandbox. I installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present), created the quickstart script following the docs' Python (OpenAI SDK) example, and obtained a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model. The exact model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1` listed in the quickstart returned a 404 (Model not found), so I listed available models via the API and used `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash-0731` instead, which returned a valid chat completion: a Spanish greeting explanation.
deviations: The quickstart specifies model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, but that model returned a 404 Not Found error. I used the API to list available models and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-flash-0731`, which worked and returned a chat completion.
